name: Find the Plushies! [118]
desc:
🧸 Find the Plushies! [118]

There are more than hundreds of plushies hidden all across the biomes. 🌍
Explore colorful cities, beaches, parks, and secret areas.
Solve small puzzles, explore hidden paths, and uncover secrets to find them all!

Some plushies are easy.
Some are tricky.
Some are very sneaky… 👀
Can you collect them all?

👍 Like & Favorite if you’re having fun!
⭐ New plushies and updates coming regularly.
